core_meaning.primary_meaning: Ghazalat is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Gazelle”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Ghazalat corresponds to the Arabic form غزالات (Arabic root غ ز ل (gh-z-l); plural of غزالة (Ghazāla)). Its core sense is gazelles (plural). Ghazalat (غزالات) is the plural of غزالة (ghazāla) 'gazelle' — 'gazelles'. The source gloss 'elegant verse, poem' confuses it with غزل (ghazal, the poetic form); the 'gazelles' sense is the correct lexical reading of this shape.
